description: While artificial intelligence is fueling predictions of sweeping industrial change, turning that promise into practical gains on factory floors -- and bringing those benefits to smaller manufacturers -- remains a work in progress. title: Siemens CEO outlines path to bring industrial AI to smaller manufacturers

description: About 50 senior executives from Samsung Group met with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on Saturday to discuss how artificial intelligence could transform corporate management and create new business opportunities. Samsung said it hosted the meeting at its Human Resources Development Center in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, bringing together presidents and other top executives from major affiliates spanning electronics, finance and biotechnology. title: Samsung executives meet OpenAI's Altman to discuss AI strategy

description: President Lee Jae Myung visited a southeastern province Saturday to inspect a government pilot program providing a monthly basic income to residents in depopulated rural towns. Lee shared details of his unannounced trip to North Gyeongsang Province in a social media post, extending greetings to residents in Yeongyang and Cheongsong counties, located in the same province. title: Lee visits southeastern province to inspect pilot basic income scheme

description: Korea’s most coveted souvenirs may be pocket-size tokens of cuteness, and more tourists now save suitcase space for plush toys, character key chains and stickers alongside their K-beauty and K-food hauls. Prominent on their itineraries sits Artbox, a four-decade-old stationery chain whose quirky lifestyle goods and trinkets — a far cry from the school supplies of its early days — have put it in the same league as Olive Young, Musinsa and Daiso. title: A box full of K-cuteness: Artbox takes on the world

description: It took a decade, but one of K-drama’s most beloved on-screen pairings is back. After winning over audiences with their signature bickering banter in the 2016 ratings smash "Dr. Romantic," Yoo Yeon-seok and Seo Hyeon-jin are joining forces again, this time in a psychological thriller steeped in lies and suspicion. title: K-drama's beloved duo Yoo Yeon-seok, Seo Hyeon-jin reunites after 10 years

description: How a society dies can reveal how it lives. From childbirth to suicide and cancer, this series examines what mortality trends tell us about South Korea today. This is the third installment of Behind the Numbers, exploring dementia’s shadow over the final days of life. — Ed.  Hardly a day passes without a missing person alert popping up on South Koreans' phones. title: When dementia makes aging dangerous

description: The waters off Yeosu in South Jeolla Province will be lit up with fireworks Saturday evening. The 2026 Yeosu Night Sea Fireworks Festival will run from 7 p.m. to 9:10 p.m. at the Yeosu World Expo Center in Deokchung-dong, according to Yeosu City. First held in 2016, the festival has since become one of the coastal city’s signature events. The centerpiece is a maritime fireworks show in two parts. An invited team from the Philippines will open this year's festival with a display themed on island
title: Fireworks to light up Yeosu seafront

description: Just below the summit of Baegundae, a line forms on bare granite. Hikers wait their turn to pose beside the Taegeukgi, the Korean national flag, planted at the top of Seoul's highest peak, 836 meters above sea level, as the city spreads out below them. Many in the line are not Korean. "For the past three years or so, it feels like more and more foreigners have been coming. Even today, more than half of the hikers are foreigners," said Park Sun-gyu, director of public relations at the Korea Natio
title: Chasing fall colors to the top of Seoul

description: Foreign tourists in Busan are turning to social media to find restrooms, swapping locations and access codes for toilets in shops and cafes. A search for “Busan restroom passwords” on Xiaohongshu — China's leading lifestyle and social commerce platform — returned dozens of posts as of Wednesday. In some posts, users share restroom locations and entry codes, while others checked whether the information was still accurate. title: Where’s the restroom? In Busan, social media has the answer

description: From sugar-dusted tomato slices, a childhood treat beloved by generations of Koreans, to spicy malatang and modern reinterpretations of traditional dishes, tomatoes are taking on new roles in Korea’s evolving food culture. For many Koreans, tomatoes evoke memories of childhood. Some grew up eating sliced tomatoes sprinkled with sugar as snacks. Others remember "Toma Toma," a tomato-shaped ice pop first introduced in 2005 but brought back in 2017 by popular demand. Millennials grew up listening t
title: From kimchi to malatang, tomatoes take on new flavors in Korea

description: Most of us have something in our past that we would rather keep buried. In an age when a years-old accusation on social media can pop up out of nowhere and get you canceled overnight, the worst-case scenario isn’t hard to picture: all of those secrets coming out at the worst possible time, say, in the last round of interviews for your dream job. Based on a novel by Akinari Asakura, “Final Interview” builds a closed-room mystery thriller around that nightmare scenario. Six college graduates make
title: In ‘Final Interview,’ landing the job means burying your friends

description: South African novelist Damon Galgut, whose fiction explores his country's history, racial inequality and the lives shaped by both, has been named the recipient of the 15th Park Kyongni Prize. At a news conference Wednesday in Seoul, Galgut spoke of his wish to write beyond the historical and political constraints that have long shaped South African literature, while acknowledging the obligation he feels to reckon with his country's turbulent past. "To confess to you, I would love to be free of t
title: South African novelist wants to write a love story. But can he separate it from history?

description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said Saturday that the country should continue supporting multicultural families but must correct policies that are unreasonable or result in reverse discrimination. “Support for multicultural families is necessary, but that does not justify specific policies that are unreasonable or lead to reverse discrimination,” Lee wrote on X, formerly Twitter. “Just because a general principle is right does not mean every specific policy based on it is also right,” he a
title: Lee calls for review of multicultural family benefits over reverse discrimination concerns

description: A group of hikers walks through fields of silver grass in full bloom near the summit of Mount Mindungsan in Jeongseon, Gangwon Province, on Saturday, enjoying the picturesque scenery of late autumn. Tourist destinations across South Korea drew visitors seeking to enjoy the fall foliage and crisp weather, as temperatures dipped from the previous day. description: Hanwha Defense USA, the US subsidiary of Hanwha Aerospace, has secured a $269 million deal to construct a medium landing ship for the US Navy and Marine Corps at its Philly shipyard, marking a major step in South Korean defense group's push into the American naval shipbuilding market. The company said Friday it was selected by US maritime services company Tote Services to build one medium landing ship, or LSM, with options for three additional vessels. title: Hanwha wins first US Navy shipbuilding contract in $269 million deal

description: A fishing boat caught fire off the Yellow Sea island of Yeongheung on Saturday and all 22 people aboard were rescued, with two of them taken to a hospital for inhaling smoke, officials said. The fire broke out on the 9.77-ton charter fishing boat in waters 0.9 nautical mile south of the island at 6:51 a.m. After receiving a distress call from the boat, the Coast Guard sent patrol and rescue boats to the scene, put out the fire and rescued all aboard. description: Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party said Saturday he has been issued a US visa for a trip to the US Pacific Command, days after he said his application was rejected. Jin, who serves as chairman of the parliamentary defense committee, said in a Facebook post that he received the visa from the US Embassy in Seoul and that it was fortunate the US State Department has issued the official A-2 visa, albeit belatedly. description: The top diplomats of South Korea, the US and Japan reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea and the full implementation of UN Security Council resolutions during trilateral talks on Friday. description: North Korean hackers purportedly stole an estimated $6.36 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, in what would be the biggest cryptocurrency theft on record, according to a US blockchain intelligence firm. TRM Labs said Thursday's attack against Binance was most likely carried out by TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group, which stole digital assets from Binance across 10 blockchain networks. title: N. Korean hackers blamed for record $6.3b Binance cryptocurrency theft: US firm
